description.text: The ex Start Decks, released on 7 July 2023: eight 60-card decks, one for each type, each built around one Pokémon ex: Grass Decidueye ex, Fire Victini ex, Water Greninja ex, Lightning Miraidon ex, Psychic Clefable ex, Fighting Koraidon ex, Darkness Houndoom ex and Metal Melmetal ex. Every card in them is non-holo, and each came with damage counters and markers. A random box, the Omakase ex Start Deck, held one of ten decks: the eight and two special decks built around Terastal Pokémon, Dragonite ex and Greedent ex, which take no attack damage while on the Bench. The two special decks were later sold on their own, from 24 November 2023.
